facts_raw.Program: 奇绩创坛 2026 秋季创业营
facts_raw.Location: 北京 + 华东 / 深圳 / 线上面试
facts_raw.Focus: AI、大模型/Agent、机器人、B2B、量子、生物科技、商业航天、出海等
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: 7% equity；已有融资项目可按上一轮估值同步投资
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 只有创始人可参加，申请人必须至少持有团队5%股权；从 idea 到 Series A 均可，全球/全国均可。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 简明具体的用户/价值定义、强技术/产品能力、快速迭代、巨大市场；AI/机器人/硬科技等尤其契合。
facts_raw.Format: 3个月创业营；团队无需常驻北京
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 不要求常住北京；但录取创始人及主要成员需在9–12月参加为期3个月创业营，并按安排参加线下活动。
facts_raw.International Founder: 可接受不同地点团队；主要项目语言/活动以中国创业环境为主。
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 中国境内活动，国际创始人需自行解决入境/居留。
facts_raw.Deadline / Next Intake: 2026秋季常规申请已截止；延期申请仍开放
facts_raw.Application Materials: 在线申请；团队、产品/用户、视频等。官方强调简明具体有洞察。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 公开邮箱 + 微信小助手 + 官网申请。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio；AI / AI-native；B2B / Enterprise SaaS；阶段以 Idea–Series A（核心为极早期） 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品；只有想法、无 MVP/traction 的极早期项目
facts_raw.Notes: Foundshore 中国区最高优先级之一。每年2期；先投资后加速；Demo Day 面向大量投资人。

facts.Location: Beijing / East China / Shenzhen / online interviews
facts.Focus: AI, large models and agents, robotics, B2B, quantum technology, biotech, commercial space and international expansion.
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: 7% equity; companies that have already raised funding may receive investment at their previous-round valuation.
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Founders only; each applicant must hold at least 5% of the team equity. Idea through Series A; applications accepted globally.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Specific customer value, strong technical or product ability, rapid iteration and a large market, especially AI, robotics and deeptech.
facts.Format: Three-month founder camp; teams do not need to live in Beijing.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Beijing residency is not required. Selected founders and key team members must participate in the three-month September–December camp and scheduled in-person activities.
facts.International Founder: Teams from different locations may participate; language and activities primarily follow the Chinese startup environment.
facts.Visa / Relocation: Activities take place in China; international founders must arrange lawful entry and residence.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Regular Fall 2026 applications have closed; late applications remain open.
facts.Application Materials: Online application covering the team, product, users and video. Responses should be concise, specific and insightful.
facts.Public Contact Route: Published email, WeChat assistant and official application.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio; AI / AI-native; B2B / Enterprise SaaS; primarily at the Idea–Series A (primarily very early stage) stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product; Idea-only projects without an MVP or traction
facts.Notes: A high-priority China program in the source assessment. Two cohorts per year, investment before acceleration and an investor-focused Demo Day.
